marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind south 20 knots veering to west 20 near midnight then
diminishing to light Sunday morning. Flurries Sunday afternoon and evening. Fog patches forming
late overnight and dissipating Sunday afternoon. Fog patches reforming Sunday
evening. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>
